calibration.budget_scope: Eligible unit-nights in each spell's own 30-night window containing its start
calibration.score_limit: Model sensitivity scores, not validated false-alarm or extinction probabilities.
calibration.eligibility: Each source's own 29 nights immediately before each scan; frozen before scoring.
calibration.family_definition: Each spell has its own 30-night fleet window containing its start: end at its last dark night (as-of while ongoing); for spells longer than 30 nights, keep the first 30 nights. Sum eligible source units in that window, with a floor of one tested unit per available evaluation night (at most 30); budget 0.1 per such scan. Ended spells keep their window on later builds.

tier_rules.High: Source baseline: preceding 29 nights, ≥12 clear nights, ≥80% with detections, median ≥3 MW; dated pre-spell heat ≥3 MW from ≥3 clear detections; ≥6 clear dark nights across ≥2 satellites; no sampled detection within 3 km; measured non-losing comparison coverage within 10 km; conservative score ≤0.1 over eligible unit-nights in the spell's own 30-night fleet scan containing its start.
tier_rules.Mid: The same recently bright source and satellite/absence checks, ≥6 clear dark nights, and shared heat loss or a conservative score above budget. Missing or unresolved comparison coverage caps a passing score at Mid. Independent-night scores never determine a tier.
tier_rules.Watch: Ongoing darkness with ≥28 clear nights, ≥12 prior detected nights, dated pre-spell heat from ≥3 clear detections, and ≥2 satellites, for sources failing the recent bright rule. Previously reduced heat is dated before the spell.

heat_upper_bound.assumption: One clear opportunity per night, independent nights; conditioned on flames detectable at least once. Below the smallest detected class is untested.

context.label: no comparison flare within 10 km
context.limit: Geographic co-change does not identify a shared gas system or cause. Isolation requires ≥3 measured nights at each comparison flare within 10 km and enough non-losing coverage to rule out shared loss even if every unknown night lost heat; cloud-only detections are unknown.

why_flagged: 110 clear nights with no flare seen across 3 satellites. No detection within 3 km in the sampled clusters (searched within ±2 pixels of GFW sites).
Heat before darkness: 3.57 MW (n=25 clear detections), from the dated normal heat regime.
No comparison flare within 10 km; this describes measured heat, not the cause.
limits: These data cannot show that a flare is out, that gas is vented, or that a stop was unplanned.
A flame smaller than any detected looks like no flame. Cloud and source-location errors remain possible.
The heat bound is conditional on detectable-flame re-detection rates and independent nights; it is not a physical upper limit.
